tools.name: launch_tape_overview
tools.description: What Launch Tape records, dataset descriptions, US dollar plan prices and coverage limits. History starts October 3, 2026; coverage varies by dataset. Use days_available for the exported UTC day range.

tools.name: graduation_stats
tools.description: One UTC day: graduate counts, down 90% at 30 minutes, positive/doubled 30-minute changes and median curve fill; followed, gap-free, full tapes only. History starts October 3, 2026; coverage varies by dataset. Use days_available for the exported UTC day range.

tools.name: lookup_coin
